changelog:
Improve Claude Sonnet 5 and GPT-5.6 model compatibility, preserve repeated stream deltas and image-adjacent tool results, add optional safe unlisted-model pass-through, and support bounded multi-round WebSearch with mixed client tools and account failover.
改进 Claude Sonnet 5 和 GPT-5.6 模型兼容，保留重复流式增量与图片相邻的工具结果，新增可选的安全格式未列出模型透传，并支持有界多轮 WebSearch、混合客户端工具和账号故障切换。
